name: Malvos
description: A marooned Sangrazul and Nohr's mentor who later serves Nazir as an apothecary.

description_citations.text: "The Cursed Land". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Instigated by Malvos, Nohr destroys the Clan Tree trying to become a planeswalker; the isle splits in two and Nohr and his descendants are cursed with madness.
timeline.quote: the wizard Nohr destroyed the tree trying to become a planeswalker

citation.text: "Cridhe", section "The Parting". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Malvos gives Nohr Soulslayer and Nohr swears to break the tree to gain planeswalkerhood.
timeline.quote: Nohr swore to break the tree to gain planeswalkerhood .

citation.text: "Haen", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lorris aids Aylith and Jedhian's escape and steals a boat with Arn to pursue Nazir.
timeline.quote: She aided Aylith and Jedhian in their escape

citation.text: "Lorris", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Malvos steals Tempé's mana as payment and is exiled to Cridhe, marked with snake tattoos that would kill him if he thought of touching mana.
timeline.quote: Malvos stole Tempé's mana as payment for his services.

citation.text: "Malvos", section "Imprisonment on Cridhe". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Cridhe Malvos discovers the hidden Clan Tree and plans to make someone a planeswalker with its mana.
timeline.quote: he found an enormous source of mana hidden even from Planeswalkers' eyes

citation.text: "Malvos", section "Imprisonment on Cridhe". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Malvos gives Nohr the sword Soulslayer; the magical rays miss the mana line and destroy the Clan Tree, causing the Parting.
timeline.quote: the Clan Tree was destroyed, causing the Parting

citation.text: "Malvos", section "Imprisonment on Cridhe". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In 4064 AR Malvos assists Nazir in investigating the raiding party's failure and in interrogating Aylith.
timeline.quote: Malvos assisted Nazir in investigating the failure.

citation.text: "Malvos", section "The Mending of the Clan Tree". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Malvos goes with Nazir to Inys Haen to force the Awakening Ritual, but Aylith's allies arrive and Nazir flees, leaving Malvos behind.
timeline.quote: Malvos remained behind to control the situation

citation.text: "Malvos", section "The Mending of the Clan Tree". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Malvos grasps Soulslayer when Feryar confronts him; its serpents bite him, he is captured and forced to teach Jedhian, and the blade crumbles.
timeline.quote: the silver serpents embedded in it came to life, sinking their fangs into his flesh

citation.text: "Malvos", section "The Mending of the Clan Tree". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Crippled after the Mending, Malvos is visited by Tempé, tells her what he knows, and is devoured by a hungry shroud.
timeline.quote: collapsing around him, devouring him whole

citation.text: "Malvos", section "The Mending of the Clan Tree". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Malvos and Crephas, trying to make an invisible cloak, accidentally create the shrouds.
timeline.quote: Attempting to create an invisible cloak, Malvos and Crephas combined a patch of lint from a Haenish cloak

citation.text: "Shapeshifter", section "Cridhe". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nohr confronts Haen and destroys the Clan Tree with Soulslayer, breaking the sword tip into his own chest.
timeline.quote: When Haen refuses to reveal the mana line, Nohr lashes out at the tree with the sword, sending out a freezing beam that causes the Clan Tree to explode into icy chunks.

citation.text: "The Cursed Land", section "The Parting". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nazir and Malvos secretly depart to strike Inys Haen.
timeline.quote: Fearing the rebellion, Nazir and Malvos take their best forces and secretly depart Inys Nohr to strike Inys Haen

citation.text: "The Cursed Land", section "Flight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Malvos uses Soulslayer and is bitten by its silver snakes; Jedhian heals him at the cost of the sword crumbling.
timeline.quote: His snake tattoos and the silver snakes worked into the sword's hilt to come to life and bite him.

citation.text: "The Cursed Land", section "Counterstrike". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Malvos is consumed by a shroud disguised as a tent after Tempé visits him.
timeline.quote: which lulls him to sleep with a magical song and then collapses upon him, consuming him.

citation.text: "The Cursed Land", section "The death of Malvos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Promised to teach him to planeswalk
relations.quote: promising to teach him to become a Planeswalker himself
